keywords: Revisionary jurisdiction; Article 138 Constitution; excise offence — illicit liquor possession; exceptional circumstances despite availability of statutory appeal remedy; bad character evidence; previous conviction record disclosed via B-Report; Section 54 Evidence Ordinance; fair trial principle; dock statement evidentiary value; no retrial ordered (police witness advantage concern
legistation: Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka — Article 138 (revisionary jurisdiction); Article 154P (appellate jurisdiction of Provincial High Court) Excise Ordinance — Section 47(1) (possession of illicit liquor) High Court of the Provinces (Special Provisions) Act No. 19 of 1990 (statutory remedy of leave to appeal/special leave to appeal from Provincial High Court appellate judgments) Evidence Ordinance — Section 54 (irrelevance of bad character evidence in criminal proceedings, subject to exceptions; Explanation 2 — previous conviction relevant as bad character evidence only where character is itself in issue)
